name: Read my Lips
description: An interactive installation isolating viewers' lips and predicting their emotions.

text: This project takes the term 'read my lips' quite literally. It lets your emotions become living words, painted right on your mouth. The canvas? Your lips themselves, displayed on the screen.

The lips usually give an added layer to our conversations, an important aspect of listening that we lost access to during the pandemic. That's what sparked this project. Strip away everything but the lips, and see if they could carry the weight of meaning alone.

Built with face-API, the system uses face landmarks to reconstruct the lips from detected points. The expression with the highest probability determines the color of the fill, turning each fleeting emotion into a visible imprint.
